data.name: Balvinder
data.gender_notes: Balvinder is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Balvinder is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Bal' meaning strength and 'Vindra' meaning victorious. It is a name of great power, symbolizing bravery and the ability to overcome adversity. The name Balvinder carries the meaning “Strong, Brave, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Balvinder usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brave, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Balvinder belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Brave, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balvinder total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
